MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The router felt relevant because reliable WiFi supports both my streaming devices and connected cameras, though I would only consider replacing mine if it needed improvement.",
    "The Echo Show felt like a useful addition because Alexa controls and video calling offer new uses alongside my existing Fire TV setup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV sticks repeat something I already have and offer no clear improvement over my 4K stick and Fire TV television.",
    "The earbuds, large external drive, tablet, and mouse do not address a current need suggested by my home viewing and monitoring purchases.",
    "The WYZE camera fits my interest in home monitoring, but I would pass because I already have Foscam and Blink cameras and no clear need for another."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Amazon device purchases seemed to be treated as interest in more Amazon devices, even when they duplicate equipment or introduce a use I have not sought.",
    "My electronics purchases seemed to imply interest in unrelated accessories, although owning a monitor or video camera does not mean I need a mouse or substantial external storage."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters is whether an item adds a useful capability to my existing setup, rather than simply resembling something I already own.",
    "My recent camera and television purchases suggest those needs may already be covered; another purchase would need a specific purpose or meaningful improvement."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected-home and viewing interests but often confused familiar devices with useful next purchases."
}
